card.summary: A free OpenBSD shell account on a pubnix: SSH, a home directory served over HTTP at tilde.institute/~user, mail in maildir, IRC clients, and a wiki. No disk ...

free_tier.stated: A free OpenBSD shell account on a pubnix: SSH, a home directory served over HTTP at tilde.institute/~user, mail in maildir, IRC clients, and a wiki. No disk quota, RAM figure or traffic allowance is published on the home page, the FAQ or the signup page.
free_tier.notes: no quota of any kind is stated on the pages read; that is a documented absence, not a documented limit

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a home directory, not an object

retention.stated: not stated: no inactivity clock or deletion policy appears on the news page, the FAQ or the signup page

egress.terms: not stated: no traffic volume or bandwidth figure appears on any page read

record.interface_detail: SSH on the default port to an OpenBSD host; web space at https://tilde.institute/~user; git hosting at git.tilde.institute from the home directory; mail in maildir; IRC via the tilde.chat network
record.tooling: any SSH client; a shell on OpenBSD; the site's wiki
record.chaining: a free OpenBSD shell with a web directory and mail, which is a place to run a small script or publish a page, and is currently at risk of losing SSH access

limits.value: there is no form: 'Please join the IRC network and hang out for a while. You'll be able to request an account from there.'
no disk, memory or process quota is published anywhere read

record.binding_note: the account is granted by an admin on IRC after the applicant has spent time in the channel, and no quota is published to plan against even once granted

identity_cost.detail: No card, no hold, no phone, no document. Joining is an IRC conversation: 'Please join the IRC network and hang out for a while. You'll be able to request an account from there. Connection details: institute.tilde.chat, Port 6697, TLS required.' There is no signup form to read, so what the account request itself asks for is not established.

record.reliability_note: the operator's news of 2026-10-22 states: 'PHP has been removed entirely. I will either be setting aside time to rebuild this whole thing on OpenBSD 8.0 soon, or I will need to turn off SSH access until I can make time.' That is a live statement that SSH access may be switched off
record.confidence_note: the joining procedure, the services and the at-risk notice are quoted from first-party pages read; the quota is a documented absence; no account was requested

record.notes: Tilde Institute provides public access Unix shell environments on OpenBSD systems for educational and community use. Resource allocations are shared among active users.

extras.price_arithmetic: no price: the service is free and there is no form that could collect payment
